logp.method_description: The octanol–water partition coefficients for compounds were determined by a modification of the reported shake-flask method. (87) Water (50 mL, ultrapure) and n-octanol (50 mL) were shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. The suspension was allowed to separate at least for one week in the dark. A solution of the complex was prepared in the water phase (3 × 10–3 M) and an equal volume of octanol was added. Biphasic solutions were mixed for 10 min and then centrifuged for 10 min at 6000 rpm to allow separation. Concentration in both phases was determined by ICP-OES as already described. (88,46) Reported LogP is defined as log([complex]oct/[complex]wat). Final values were reported as the mean of two determinations.
